why: Serves the cached value for every property of a hit rather than `display` alone. hud.css's `:focus`, `:focus-visible`, `:hover` and `:active` rules change other properties, and focus moves no longer empty the cache, so a hit must read everything but `display` fresh. The `:focus` color case reads `color` and `getPropertyValue('color')` through a hit after a focus move.
killedBy: computed-style-cache: what a hit returns reads every property but display fresh, so a :focus color shows after a focus move
